Slop Photo Sorter · Live

Photo sorter: swipe to keep the best

Swipe through photos: like, dislike, tag, keep the best. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

Slop Photo Sorter has these main features: Drop photos or a whole folder, then swipe one at a time; Like, dislike, skip and tag with the arrow keys or the buttons. It opens Any image.

What you can do with Slop Photo Sorter

  • Cull a photo shoot with the arrow keys
